sources.title: Breast Cancer Classification Using Fine-Tuned SWIN Transformer Model on ...
sources.snippet: This study conducted a comparative analysis of pre-trained CNNs (ResNet50 and VGG16) and Vision Transformers (ViT-Base and SWIN Transformer) with the inclusion of ViT-Base trained from scratch model architectures to effectively classify breast cancer mammographic images into benign and malignant cases.
